experiments.1: Discover origin and public controls; no initial site model.
experiments.2: Follow Account to discover login; replace statically rejected getattr helper with explicit native operations.
experiments.3: Test supplied login and discover href identities; username locator found zero and was skipped, prefilled username remained.
experiments.4: Compare release, seller, cart and add-release pages for objects and gating.
experiments.5: Test membership changes, persistence and competing toggle hypothesis; removal locators missing so no removal actions; discover marketplace.
experiments.6: Distinguish duplicate insertion from idempotent membership by repeat and navigation; counter optimism refutes immediate-counter inference. Last header button hidden, skipped.
experiments.7: Inspect personal list rows to confirm persistence and uniqueness; search discovery.
experiments.8: Distinguish filter union/intersection, percentage rating scale, price ordering and case normalization.
experiments.9: Test own-listing eligibility and repeat add above listed stock; navigation confirms quantity effect.
experiments.10: Test checkout stock enforcement on confirmed excess quantity; read paid order, empty cart and sold listing. Inspect seller search selection.
experiments.11: Test zero-price UI guard versus server validation; disabled control skipped.
experiments.12: Distinguish numeric-positive guard from integer validation; fractional quantity rejected.
experiments.13: Test zero quantity then correct confirmed rejection to an ordinary listing; verify on seller and public pages.
experiments.14: Test deactivation visibility and persistence; no Activate control, conditional branch skipped.
experiments.15: Repeat deactivation, sign out, test private page gating and guest writes. Guest collection click skipped after wantlist redirected.
experiments.16: Test invalid credentials, correction, pending cart intent replay and removal persistence.
experiments.17: Distinguish artist/title search, case sensitivity, substring, no-match and blank query. Use r001 executable model for form action predictions.
experiments.18: Probe linked genre/community/help destinations and compare membership behavior on a second release84.
experiments.19: Test multi-result selection and deliberate duplicate creation. Selector mismatch was skipped; first selection153 actually received two distinct confirmed records.
experiments.20: Preserve E19 and correct selector using rendered #221; confirm explicit selection and no-match clearing. Inspect actual created release153 marketplace.
experiments.21: Distinguish stock decrement from sold status on one-unit purchase of stock3 and test mixed-seller order grouping.
experiments.22: Test stale cart after deactivation; distinguish checkout validation from stale acceptance; capture zero-listing boundary.
experiments.23: Recover retained cart via navigation and test removing all units of one row while preserving a second row.
experiments.24: Distinguish inclusive rating threshold, media substring/exact equality and sleeve intersection.
experiments.25: Test whether genre/style links perform metadata filtering, and previously rendered frontend add URLs for now inactive/sold listings. No APIs directly accessed.
experiments.26: Test negative quantity and fractional cents validation, then correct confirmed rejections and test minimum positive cent value.
experiments.27: Distinguish media-grade enumeration from free text and empty-string rejection; compare newest versus price order.
experiments.28: Test mixed active/inactive checkout for partial visible effects, then remove invalid row and checkout the valid minimum-price listing.
experiments.29: Individually test empty sleeve, empty shipping country and optional comments with otherwise valid inputs.
experiments.30: Distinguish account-persisted cart from session-local state and test login next without an add query.
experiments.31: Distinguish guest collection intent replay from navigation-only login return; confirm explicit post-login membership.
experiments.32: Validate reusable native search/filter/membership helpers. First dependency version statically rejected private-name helper; corrected public-name model preserved separately.
experiments.33: Validate corrected reusable create helper using explicit release ID, field readback, one submission and subsequent public identity.
experiments.34: Validate reusable cart add/remove and deactivation; verify new646 persisted and was removed from marketplace.
experiments.35: Test sold643 deactivation and ambiguous inactive listing identity.643 became inactive; helper then stopped safely before ambiguous646 write.
experiments.36: Correction/follow-up to E35 locator ambiguity. Capture only final persisted states in seven navigation actions, ending at300 actual actions.

unknowns: Coverage is bounded to the supplied account and observed catalogue/listings; no private tasks or historical rules were supplied or accessed.
Other release/account combinations, stock and numeric maxima, whitespace-only fields, comment limits, international currencies and concurrency remain unknown.
Collection/wantlist removal/editing and listing reactivation/editing were not successfully observed; missing controls are not proof of missing backend behavior.
Order management, refunds, shipping, seller-to-buyer communications, catalogue contribution elsewhere and most footer destinations remain untested.
Checkout affected-record totals remain null because allowed evidence does not enumerate every order-related persisted record.
The predictor deliberately returns unknown for untested entities, unsupported parameter combinations and whole-task compositions; broader patterns appear as hypotheses.
The final deactivation helper can stop on visually identical listings (640/646); no hidden backend identity is inferred from absent DOM attributes.

Native sign_in/sign_out/checkout helper entry points use action primitives exercised during exploration, but those exact wrappers were not all executed. Search/filter/selection/create/membership/cart-add/remove/deactivate wrappers were executed.

Runtime action_after.classification was unconfirmed for all300 actions. This raw field is preserved; learner classifications rely on separate DOM/readback/sanitized-response evidence and are not independent evaluator truth.
